subject: incorrect column name crashes R in dplyr

messages.author: c1fd473cb3f1870e
messages.subject: incorrect column name crashes R in dplyr
parts:
On my machine, the following code crashes my R session:

out <- data.frame(IC1=runif(100),IC2=runif(100),IC3=runif(100))
out <- tbl_df(out)
summarise(out, IC1=mean(IC1), IC2=mean(IC2), IC3=mean(IC4))

The problem is there is no column named IC4, so its my fault, but there might be a nicer way to tell the user he made a mistake than to crash the R session.

Thanks,

Roger
